name: Banana Ranch
source: Our protagonist is a country boy who decided to move to Banana Town. However, strange things happened during his way to Banana Town, and he was suddenly transported to a different world. The town he arrived at was still called Banana Town, but all the town citizens have somehow transformed into humanoid animals. Moreover, the ranch he was going to work at was not hiring at all, it was even on the verge of bankruptcy!
translation: 主人公是一位决定搬到香蕉镇的乡下青年。然而，前往香蕉镇的途中发生了怪事，他突然被传送到了另一个世界。他抵达的小镇依然叫香蕉镇，但镇上的居民不知为何全都变成了人形动物。更糟的是，他原本要去工作的牧场根本不招人，甚至已经濒临破产！
